coverage.design_evaluation_explanation: Matches 11 of 17 ground-truth variable items (65%): consistent train/validation/test splitting, sequence length, forecast horizon, cycle length, model type, input/output dimensions, RevIN usage, normalization, cycle/phase indexing, MSE, and MAE.
coverage.design_error_analysis: Uses AdamW with a composite time/frequency/phase loss instead of the specified Adam with MSE. Omits the RTX 4090 hardware specification, 30-epoch training setting, batch size, synthetic-data generation parameters, and training-loss/learned-cycle visualizations. The lengthy proposed architecture and additional metrics do not substitute for these missing variables.
coverage.conclusion_evaluation_explanation: The conclusion output is empty and therefore does not semantically match the ground-truth conclusion.
coverage.conclusion_error_analysis: Fails to state the expected result: a trained CycleNet model capable of accurate forecasting, accompanied by visualizations of historical data, ground truth, predictions, and learned cyclic patterns.
